CustomField.description: Set automatically on every insert and update by FundFieldApplicabilityHistoryTrigger (FundFieldApplicabilityHistoryHandler): true when FieldAPIName__c is listed in Tracked_Fields__c of the Field_History_Config__mdt record of the referenced object (validity period with Start/End Date, at most one open per record and field); false for the one-off audit lines of FieldHistoryLogger.logAllFields.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked: validity period of a tracked field (start/end date). Unchecked: one-off audit entry. Set automatically from the field history configuration; a manual value is overwritten.
CustomField.label: Applicability
